model.stratum: Written dimension-uniform vector-valued reverse Poincare and flat-frame Banach range constructor. The geometric first-order connection is retained; the bounded C2 Hessian multiplier is not differentiated. Continuous HS force derivatives give same-leaf Lipschitz estimates, a factorial entrance-from-infinity bound, pathwise uniqueness and an adapted marked-noise strong solution map. Independent analytic review and actual finite-box coupled-map transport remain open.
missing_constructors: actual finite-source strong maps transported on the same marked Wiener input
model.next_falsifier: The traced gradient estimate gains a volume factor, the invariant-frame first-order connection is dropped, an unproved D3 multiplier estimate is used, an ell2 Gronwall step precedes same-leaf membership, or marginal path laws are substituted for the marked-noise joint arrow.
